title: Add a user: an empty Save shows only "Enter the person's name." - Sign-in ID and Password (also required) get no message
steps:
1. Users > Add user
2. Leave every field empty
3. Click Add user
actual: One banner "Enter the person's name." at the bottom. Sign-in ID * and Password * are not marked and have no message; the user only learns about them one by one.
expected: Every required field (Name, Sign-in ID, Password) is marked red with its own message at the same time (like Add sub-agent shows a message per field).

title: Required-field messages look different on every form: "Required" under each field (Add sub-agent) vs one banner "Enter the person's name." (Add user)
screen: Sub-agents > Add sub-agent, Users > Add user
steps:
1. Sub-agents > Add sub-agent > Save with an empty form
2. Users > Add user > Add user with an empty form
actual: Add sub-agent: "Required" under each field. Add user: a single red banner with a sentence for the first missing field only.
expected: One style everywhere: each missing required field marked red with "<Field> is required".

title: Checkout: "Pay" stays disabled and nothing says which fields are missing
steps:
1. Search hotels Dubai > Marina Bay Hotel > Book
2. On Checkout leave the form empty
3. Try to click "Pay AED 2,203.20"
actual: The Pay button is greyed out; no field is marked and no message tells the agent that Email, Mobile, Your reference, guest Title / First name / Last name and the terms tick are still needed.
expected: Pay is clickable (or the missing fields are listed); clicking it marks every missing required field with a message.

title: Wallet transactions show internal codes ("Booking chk_9", "Refund ldg_25") instead of the booking number / confirmation
steps:
1. Book a hotel on the credit line (booking #000009, confirmation PH261121-W4TUYR)
2. Cancel it
3. Wallet & credit > Transactions
actual: Charge row: "Credit · Booking · chk_9"; refund row: "Credit · Refund · ldg_25". The booking number #000009 is not shown at all; the charge row has no confirmation number.
expected: Both rows show the booking number (#000009) and confirmation (PH261121-W4TUYR) so the agent can match money to bookings and invoices.

title: Same booking shows two dates: "Booked 21 Nov 2026" in Bookings but "22 Nov 2026 01:32" in Wallet transactions (UTC vs local time)
screen: Bookings list / detail, Wallet & credit > Transactions
steps:
1. Book after midnight local time (here 22 Nov 2026 01:32 India time = 21 Nov 20:02 UTC)
2. Compare Bookings (Booked ...) with Wallet & credit > Transactions
actual: Bookings list and detail: "Booked 21 Nov 2026"; Wallet transactions: "22 Nov 2026 01:32" for the same booking. The confirmation number PH261121-... also carries the UTC date.
expected: One date everywhere, in the agent's / company's time zone.

title: Cancellation table is ambiguous: "Free cancellation until 6 Jan" but the table says no charge until 7 Jan, boundary days appear in two rows, and "21 Jan → 21 Jan 100%" is listed twice
screen: Checkout > Cancellation & details, Booking > Cancel booking
steps: 1. Marina Bay Hotel 21-24 Jan 2027 > Book > Cancellation & details (or Cancel booking on the booking)
actual: Header "Free cancellation until 6 Jan 2027"; rows: Booking → 7 Jan no charge, 7 Jan → 14 Jan 25%, 14 Jan → 19 Jan 50%, 19 Jan → 21 Jan 100%, 21 Jan → 21 Jan 100%. 7, 14 and 19 Jan are in two rows each - the agent cannot tell which charge applies on those days.
expected: Rows that do not overlap (e.g. until 6 Jan no charge, 7-13 Jan 25% ...), the same last free day in the header and the table, and no duplicate row.

title: Buttons and menu items are not Title Case ("Add user", "New booking", "Request higher limit", "Search & book") and "Add a user" title vs "Add user" button
steps: Open the menu and the list screens; read the buttons
actual: Sentence case on ~48 buttons / menu items, e.g. menu "Search & book", "Trip builder", "My quotations", "Package builder", "AI assistant", "Wallet & credit", "Markup earnings"; buttons "New booking", "New quotation", "Build package", "Add sub-agent", "Add user", "Request higher limit", "Go to cart", "Modify search", "New search", "Start searching". The Add user dialog is titled "Add a user" while its button says "Add user".
expected: Title Case for buttons and menu items ("Search & Book", "New Booking", "Add User", "Request Higher Limit") and the same wording in dialog title and button - the standard agreed for the ERP.

title: Page titles are not real headings - Bookings, Quotations, Wallet & credit, Users... have no heading element (screen readers and page structure miss them)
screen: Bookings, Trip builder, Quotations, My quotations, Package builder, Savings, AI assistant, Disruptions, Wallet & credit, Reports, Sub-agents, Markup, Markup earnings, Users, Profile
steps: Open any of these pages and inspect the page title (e.g. "Bookings")
actual: The big title is plain text - the page has no h1/h2 (0 headings found on 16 pages); only Home and the search pages have headings.
expected: Each page title is a heading (h1) so assistive technology, tests and page outline find it.
withdrawn: 22 Nov 2026: raised in error - titles are <h5> headings (sweep looked only for h1-h4); PB2B-24 closed as not-a-bug

title: Flight search always fails: "The supplier couldn't complete this request — please try again." (server answers 502)
steps:
1. Search & book > Flights
2. From Dubai, To Delhi, departure 29 Nov 2026, 1 passenger, Economy
3. Search flights and wait for the live search (20-60 s)
actual: After "Comparing fares..." the page shows "The supplier couldn't complete this request — please try again."; POST /flight/search answers 502. Same on every run (21-22 Nov 2026) - no flight can be found or booked.
expected: Flight results (or a clear "no flights for these dates" message); the flight supplier connection works for the agent.

title: Cruise and Rail are offered everywhere (tabs, home tiles, module access, sponsored "Europe by rail" deal) but booking is not connected
steps:
1. Search & book > Rail: London -> Paris, search
2. Search & book > Cruise: search
actual: Rail: "Rail booking isn't connected yet" - while the same page shows the sponsored deal "Europe by rail this winter - Eurostar and TGV... Hold seats for 48 hours at no charge". Cruise: "Cruise booking isn't connected yet". Both stay in the tabs, the home booking tiles and the profile's module access. Server: 503.
expected: Hide Cruise / Rail (tabs, tiles, sponsored deals) until they can be booked, or label them "on request" from the start.
withdrawn: 22 Nov 2026: not a bug (product owner answer)

title: Payments & summary of a cancelled booking shows only the refund - the original payment from the credit line is missing ("Paid AED 0.00")
steps:
1. Book a hotel paid from the credit line (AED 2,203.20)
2. Cancel it (free)
3. Open the booking > Payments & summary
actual: One line only: "Refund · Credit line · 21 Nov 2026 · rf_90c92516... - AED 2,203.20"; Total 0.00, Paid 0.00, Balance 0.00. The AED 2,203.20 charge to the credit line is not listed, so a refund appears for money that was never paid. (The refund is dated 21 Nov here but 22 Nov 01:36 in History - see the date bug.)
expected: Both movements: the payment +AED 2,203.20 (credit line, booking date) and the refund -AED 2,203.20, with readable references (booking / confirmation number instead of rf_... ids).

title: A Service voucher and a Booking confirmation can still be produced for a CANCELLED booking
steps:
1. Open a cancelled booking (#000009)
2. Documents > Service voucher (or Booking confirmation) > View
actual: The document is generated ("Voucher 000009.pdf" / "Booking confirmation 000009.pdf", POST /documents/render 200). Receipt is disabled, but voucher and confirmation are not - the agent could hand a valid-looking voucher to a guest for a cancelled stay.
expected: Voucher and booking confirmation are disabled for cancelled services (or clearly marked CANCELLED); the credit note stays available.
withdrawn: 22 Nov 2026: not a bug (product owner answer)

title: Add a user accepts an invalid email ("not-an-email") and sends it to the server
steps:
1. Users > Add user
2. Name, Sign-in ID, a valid password, Email = not-an-email
3. Add user
actual: No message on Email; the form sends {"email":"not-an-email", ...} to POST /agency-users (blocked by the test - nothing was created).
expected: "Enter a valid email address" under Email; nothing is sent.

title: Add sub-agent accepts an invalid email ("not-an-email") and sends it to the server
steps:
1. Sub-agents > Add sub-agent
2. Agency name, Contact person, Sign-in ID, a valid password, Email = not-an-email
3. Save
actual: No message on Email; the form sends {"email":"not-an-email", ...} to POST /subagents (blocked by the test - nothing was created).
expected: "Enter a valid email address"; nothing is sent.

title: Markup accepts a NEGATIVE value (-10 %) and absurd values (1000 %) - selling below cost is possible
steps:
1. Markup > My customers
2. All products: type -10 (then 1000) as % markup
3. Save
actual: No message; the page sends PUT /markup {"type":"Percentage","value":-10} and {"value":1000} (blocked by the test - nothing was saved).
expected: Markup cannot be negative and a sensible maximum (agreed with the business) is enforced, with a clear message.

title: Request higher limit: 0, a negative amount or a limit below the current one only greys out the button - no message why
steps:
1. Wallet & credit > Request higher limit
2. New limit = 0, then -500, then 1000 (current limit 50,000)
actual: The send button just becomes disabled; nothing says the new limit must be higher than AED 50,000.00.
expected: A message under New limit, e.g. "Enter a limit higher than your current AED 50,000.00".

title: Reports shows made-up "sample" margins (incl. a Visa line) and Export downloads nothing
steps:
1. Reports > Product-line performance
2. Click Export
actual: "Sample figures - live reporting isn't connected yet." with fixed margins Flights 11.0 %, Hotels 13.8 %, Packages 17.9 %, Activities 21.7 %, Visa 19.0 %, Transfers 23.2 % for an agent with no completed booking (Visa is not a product). Export: no file and no message.
expected: Real figures from the agent's own bookings (or an empty state) and a working Export - or hide the report until it is connected.

title: Users list shows "Last sign-in —" for an agent that signs in every day
steps:
1. Sign in as the QA agent (done many times on 21-22 Nov 2026)
2. Open Users
actual: QA Auto B2B Agent (you): "Last sign-in —".
expected: The date and time of the last sign-in.

title: A booking that was just confirmed and charged is missing from Bookings ("0 upcoming") - the list shows it only after reloading
steps:
1. Book a hotel and pay from the credit line ("Booking confirmed")
2. Open Bookings right away (menu or "Bookings" button)
3. Wait on the page
actual: The header already shows the credit charged (Credit AED 47,796.80) but Bookings says "0 upcoming · 2 in all" / "No upcoming bookings." The list does not refresh by itself; the booking appears only after reloading the page (seen on 3 automated runs, 22 Nov 2026).
expected: The new booking is listed as soon as it is confirmed (or the list refreshes on its own).

title: Right after a cancellation the booking page still shows "Confirmed" and "Still to pay AED 2,203.20" (although the credit was already refunded)
steps:
1. Book a hotel on the credit line (AED 2,203.20)
2. Cancel booking > accept charges (AED 0.00) and cancel - "Cancelled - AED 2,203.20 is back in your account"
3. Open / reload the booking page
actual: For about a minute or more after the cancellation the page shows: status Confirmed (booking and hotel), "AED 0.00 paid", "Still to pay AED 2,203.20", Modify booking and Add service active (Cancel booking disabled) - while the header already shows Credit AED 50,000.00 (refunded). Later it switches to Cancelled. Seen on booking #000017, 22 Nov 2026.
expected: As soon as the cancellation is confirmed the page shows Cancelled, nothing still to pay, and no Modify / Add service.

title: Flight search: typing "Dubai" offers DWC (Al Maktoum) first - DXB (Dubai International) should come first
steps:
1. Search & book > Flights
2. Click "Enter origin" and type Dubai
actual: The first option is "DWC — Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubai", DXB comes second - an agent who picks the first option searches from the wrong airport.
expected: "DXB — Dubai International Airport" first (product owner, answer to Q-16 on 22 Nov 2026: raise as bug).
